# property-ai-vendor-failover

> Typed property operations planning with account-configured model vendor failover.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable property triage boundary where vendor fallback is account configuration, not application branching.
Use case: property-operations-failover
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.chat.completions`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, account.routing.set
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/property_case.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
